description: React component for managing MCP servers, including fetching server data, filtering by team and access group, displaying server details, and handling create/delete operations.

classes.name: MCPServers
classes.description: React functional component for MCP server management interface.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the server ID to delete and opens the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Performs server deletion via API, refetches data, and manages UI state.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal without deleting.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Adds a newly created server to the list and closes the creation modal.
